title: ku- infinitive constructions: positive, negative, object-marked and reflexive
source_locator: Fortune Grammatical Constructions, section 3.3.18 Noun Class 15, PDF pages 90-91 (printed pp. 78-79); verb hiatus retention witnesses: ku-chi-end-a (Fortune p. 90); akaenda/akaona (Fortune, Hannan, FSI); kuasakura (ku-a-sakura, class-6 object), kwaakaita/kwaakaenda, raakanga/zvaakanga, Usaenda (sa- + vowel stem), ndakamuona/kumuona (object + vowel stem) (Hannan); kuita (FSI p. 162); Ndaatora (nda-a-tor-a, class-6 object), Ndamuona/Ndavaona (FSI p. 166), Mwambovaona (FSI p. 189), tisina kumuona (negative infinitive + object, FSI p. 333). Excluded: kaana (Bemba, Fortune p. 21); nominal a + a > a coalescence of section 3.3.9 (mano/meno/meso, PDF p. 64) is explicitly nominal and does not transfer to verbs.
rule_summary: Class-15 ku- infinitive lane for morphology-rules-v4: ku + reviewed verb stem, with optional sa- negation, at most one object concord or the reflexive zvi prefix, and the shared evidence-gated extension operations. Negative infinitives keep terminal -a (kusaziva), unlike finite negatives. Object and reflexive zvi readings are reported distinctly, never merged. Two a-vowel boundaries are deferred pending evidence (sa- before an a-initial concord/stem; a-final concord before an a-initial stem): such constructions return structured unsupported responses, never inferred readings.

generation_features.object: structured person/noun-class object feature or null
generation_features.extensions: shared extension list contract with evidence gating and sequence policy

conditions.generation_requires_terminal_a: verb-stem lemmas whose normalized stem does not end in -a (divergent stems such as -ti, -nzi) are refused at generation; they resolve only as their own reviewed lemmas at analysis
conditions.single_object_or_reflexive: at most one object concord or reflexivity per construction; double-object and reflexive-plus-object combinations are unsupported (no rule in the available volume)
conditions.shared_extension_policy: extension evidence gating (dz/ts causative, short reversive) and the causative < applicative < reciprocal < reversive < repetitive < neuter < passive product sequence apply unchanged from morphology-rules-v3
conditions.deferred_vowel_boundaries: sa- immediately followed by an a-initial object concord or an a-initial stem, and an a-final object concord immediately followed by an a-initial stem, are deferred pending applicable evidence (deferred_pending_evidence, never presented as ungrammatical): generation refuses them with 422 GENERATION_UNSUPPORTED and analysis infers no reading across them, while independently supported readings of the same surface stay available
conditions.feature_allowlist: infinitive generation accepts only generation_type, polarity, object, reflexive, and extensions; any other top-level feature field returns 422 GENERATION_UNSUPPORTED instead of being ignored
deferred: sa- before an a-initial object concord or stem (e.g. ku + sa + a + ziva, ku + sa + ambura)
a-final object concord before an a-initial stem (e.g. ku + va + ambura, ku + a + ambura)
progressive/exclusive formatives -cha-/-chi- (attested on p. 90 but out of this slice)
multiword complements (e.g. ku-sa-zvi-ziv-a izvi complement izvi)

examples.note: Fortune 3.3.18(2)(a): object prefix example glossed 'to take them'.
Fortune 3.3.18(2)(a): reflexive prefix example glossed 'to know oneself'; the text lists object and reflexive prefixes together but glosses them apart.
Fortune 3.3.18(2)(b): negative prefix /-sa-/ example glossed 'not to know'.

Fortune p. 91 analysis ku-sa-zvi-ziv-a (with complement izvi, 'not to know this'): negative sa- combined with the zvi object prefix. The same surface with a reflexive zvi reading is a constructed combination, reported as a second analysis.
Public analyzer/generator fixture using the approved ku + reviewed verb-stem shape.
Vowel-initial fixture; ku + vowel-initial stems keep hiatus (cf. kuasakura, kuenda).

Hannan dictionary text attests the negative infinitive after na- (nokusaziva, 'through not knowing how to hold the teapot') and the -ziva- radical in inflected use (Ndinokuzivai, 'I know you'), corroborating the Fortune construction with independent lexical material.
Fixture combination of the attested -ziva radical with the source-backed applicative allomorph; both endpoints must agree on it (round-trip).
sa- before a-initial stem is deferred pending applicable evidence: generation refuses it and analysis infers no sa + ambura reading (a reviewed -sambura still analyzes as positive ku + sambura).
Positive class-6 object infinitive ku + a + ziva; no contraction applies (cf. source-attested ku + vowel sequences kuita, kuenda), and analysis recovers the object reading directly.

sa- before a-initial object concord is deferred pending applicable evidence: generation refuses ku + sa + a + ziva and analysis infers no such reading; kusaziva keeps exactly its source-attested no-object meaning.
FSI p. 225 (Unit 21, Object prefixes): nda-a-tor-a answering 'Watorepi magwere?' (class 6); the class-6 object concord a- is retained after nda- in a verb, with hiatus.

FSI p. 333 (Unit 31): ti-sin-a ku-mu-on-a 'we left him without seeing him'; negative infinitive with object concord mu- before vowel stem -ona, hiatus retained. Also ndakamuona/kumuona (Hannan), Ndamuona/Ndavaona (FSI p. 166), Mwambovaona (FSI p. 189).

counterexamples.note: The same surface segment ku can be an object concord in supported finite verb forms, not an infinitive prefix.
Progressive -cha- infinitive (Fortune 3.3.18(2)(c)) is source-visible but outside this slice; it must 422, not silently analyze as cha + stem.
Divergent stem -ti takes no terminal -a (Fortune footnote p. 78): analysis resolves it only as its own reviewed lemma, generation refuses it.
Contracted spelling with the sa- + stem vowel merged: verbs retain hiatus (kusaambura), so this surface is produced by no v1 construction and must 422.
Deferred sa- + a-concord boundary: analysis infers no class-6 object reading (deferred_infinitive_boundary lane); the surface has no other supported reading.
Deferred a-final-concord + a-stem boundary: analysis infers no va + ambura reading (deferred_infinitive_boundary lane).

notes: Do not treat every ku segment as an infinitive prefix.
Do not merge a reflexive zvi reading into an object-concord slot.
Terminal vowel stays -a under sa- negation; do not apply the finite ha-/-e mutation here.
Every sa-/zvi-/object reading must resolve to a reviewed stem; a lexical stem that merely begins with those letters never authorizes the construction.
Rule-set history: extension allomorph, evidence-gate and sequence rules are unchanged from morphology-rules-v3; v4 adds only the infinitive negation/object/reflexive/generation lane described here.

Two a-vowel boundaries are deferred pending applicable evidence (sa- before an a-initial concord/stem; a-final concord before an a-initial stem): neither concatenated nor contracted spellings authorize an inferred reading there; independently supported readings of the same surface stay available.
Infinitive generation accepts only its five documented feature fields; anything else is a structured 422, never silently ignored.

qa.reviewer_notes: Section 3.3.18 directly attests positive, negative, object-marked, reflexive, and negative+object ku- constructions on the -tor-/-ziv- radicals. Vowel-contact witnesses (kuasakura, kwaakaita, akaenda/akaona, Usaenda, Ndaatora, ndakamuona/kumuona, tisina kumuona) support retention at attested contacts but do not establish the sa-/a-concord, sa-/a-stem, or a-concord/a-stem boundaries, which are deferred pending applicable evidence: generation refuses them (deferred_pending_evidence) and analysis infers no reading across them, while independently supported readings stay available. Excluded with reasons: kaana (Bemba, Fortune p21), saakadzama (adverbial sa-, not negative), zvaakatya (-atya stem unverified), yaanwa and Mwamboaona (ambiguous parses); nominal a + a > a (3.3.9) is explicitly nominal and not transferred. Supported extension combinations must round-trip. Progressive/exclusive formatives and divergent-stem generation stay out of scope.

api_safety.backward_compatibility: Additive under morphology-rules-v4 except the two deferred a-vowel boundaries: simple ku- readings gain a polarity object (positive) and a reflexive null slot; generation_type infinitive is new; finite verb_form shapes, extension rules, evidence gates, and the sequence convention are unchanged. Deferred-boundary requests that previously generated or analyzed now return structured unsupported responses with deferred_pending_evidence. Releases declaring older rule versions receive 503 MORPHOLOGY_RULES_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED; no release records are rewritten.
